[SWS_CORE_01296] swap overload for Array
⌈
There shall be an over-
load of the swap function within the namespace ara::core for arguments of type
Array. Its interface shall be equivalent to:
template <typename T, std::size_t N>
void swap(Array<T, N>& lhs, Array<T, N>& rhs);
This function shall exchange the state of lhs with that of rhs.
